scope: H16 first pure one-entry/one-explicit-close projection slice only

findings.issue: A close request and actual fill can predate the creation of their E5 PositionAction and still be accepted as an authorized close projection.
findings.evidence: The request is reconstructed at exit_request.created_at. The existing validate_close_authority checks action.created_at >= its source observation and now < expires_at, but has no now >= action.created_at check. The new fill window begins at max(exit_request.created_at, last entry fill), so it also does not reject this causal inversion. With the source observed at T, an action created at T+1, and its otherwise exact request/result/fill at T, the current branches permit EXIT_REQUESTED exposure projection at T+2.
findings.minimal_fix: Require the executed close request timestamp to be at or after the original action creation timestamp, while retaining validation at original execution time so a later observation does not retrospectively expire an already executed action. This can be local to the new adapter or added to the shared close-authority validator with compatibility review.
findings.minimal_regression: Use the existing actual PaperBroker/E4/E5 fixture: create the action at NOW+1, prepare/submit/fill the exact close at NOW against the source observed at NOW, and require projection rejection. Keep the existing later-observation-after-expiry positive case.

verified_static_invariants: Original positive entry basis is recomputed with the existing entry builder and compared to the original canonical source broker facts.

Exit request is reconstructed from original action/source; fill order, plan, symbol, side, action, position and role references are checked; duplicate/cross-set fills, nonfinite amounts, mismatched result totals/average and overclose are rejected.
Signed residual must match the typed snapshot, cannot increase versus previous projection, and existing lifecycle builders enforce observation/history clocks.
Unknown fees do not become zero, and partial/full observations produce EXIT_REQUESTED only. No funding, TradeResult or CLOSED is created.
Tests use actual source PaperBroker/E4/E5 producers. This is not evidence of native Productfake execution.
limits: Static source reads and raw-byte hashing only; no tests, product/native processes, Git operations, database/config/auth/provider/network reads or tracked writes.
Owner-side native identity, same-position zero attestation, complete journal selection and durable publication are outside this pure slice.
Root-reported development results are not independently executed validation or full/native/Master qualification credit.
